description: Northern Province Provincial Council - Northern Province Provincial Council, Appropriation Statute No. 04 of 2014 Adopted the Appropriation Statute on 19.12.2014 & Hon. Governor given his assent on 22.12.2014
reasoning: This gazette content announces the adoption and assent of the "Appropriation Statute No. 04 of 2014" by the Northern Provincial Council. This constitutes the enactment of a new law (a statute), which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for new laws, acts, and regulations. While it involves a government body (the Provincial Council), the core content is the notification of a legislative act, not a government personnel change or structural reorganization.
